## Research and Work Experience {.cv-section}

::: cv-entry
**Lab Manager / Research Assistant, Cognitive Science Lab** [April 2023 – June 2026]{.cv-date}\
Department of Psychology and Health Studies, University of Saskatchewan

- Managed a team of 8–12 graduate students, research assistants, and honours students: supported junior members' projects, organized regular meetings, delegated tasks, and kept communication and workflow running smoothly.
- Ran the day-to-day functioning of the lab, including financial and ethics responsibilities and data management.
- Carried out study design, data collection, and data analysis for multiple projects using SPSS, R, Gorilla, Prolific, and SONA.
- Assisted Dr. Valerie Thompson in writing a successful NSERC Discovery Grant (2023).
:::

::: cv-entry
**Editorial Skills Mentor, Undergraduate Research Journal (USURJ)** [September 2025 – April 2026]{.cv-date}\
Murray Library Writing Centre, University of Saskatchewan

- Mentored the undergraduate volunteer editors for the journal's Social Sciences section, providing writing and editorial guidance.
- Met one-on-one with editors to review submissions for writing and research quality and to craft feedback for authors.
- Helped editors develop their editing, copyediting, and communication skills and led discussions on best practices in manuscript assessment.
:::

::: cv-entry
**Writing Tutor, Murray Library Writing Centre** [September 2024 – April 2026]{.cv-date}\
University of Saskatchewan

- Helped students across disciplines (linguistics, psychology, English, nursing, education) develop academic writing for coursework, scholarships, and job and school applications.
- Gave constructive feedback on structure, grammar, clarity, and style using a student-led tutoring approach.
:::
